notes: Entities are JPA classes discovered from active @Entity annotations.
Several services map shared database tables; an entity mapping does not necessarily imply exclusive table ownership.
Services without persistence mappings have an empty entities object.

excludedModules.common-eshop: Shared Java library, not a runnable Spring Boot service.
excludedModules.common-merchant: Shared merchant library, not a runnable Spring Boot service.
excludedModules.shared-libs: Shared libraries, not a runnable Spring Boot service.
excludedModules.ui-toanchetpay: Frontend application, not a Spring Boot service.

services.name: account-service
responsibilities: Manage merchant and store settlement accounts.
Maintain merchant registration, approval, unauthorized-change, and history records.
Coordinate account information with merchant, store-setting, and connector services.

services.name: acs-bff-backoffice
responsibilities: Provide authentication and user/profile APIs for the securities back office.
Aggregate client profile, fund, investment, NAV, and history operations.
Integrate with the CSX external service.

services.name: api-gateway
responsibilities: Route external requests to downstream eShop services.
Apply gateway-level security, filtering, and cross-cutting request policies.
Provide fallback responses when downstream routes are unavailable.

services.name: bff-mobile
responsibilities: Authenticate mobile customers and maintain customer tokens.
Aggregate store, category, product, cart, order, delivery, refund, sale-event, search, and shipping-address APIs.
Translate mobile requests into calls to downstream eShop services.

services.name: bff-pos
responsibilities: Authenticate POS users and maintain POS tokens.
Aggregate POS product, category, order, dashboard, payment-summary, and user-management APIs.
Resolve merchant and partner context for POS operations.

services.name: bff-toanchetpay
responsibilities: Authenticate merchant-portal users with tokens, OTP, password history, and two-step verification.
Enforce profiles, functions, subfunctions, menu permissions, settings, and merchant context.
Aggregate product, catalog, shop, order, stock, delivery, refund, reporting, payment, notification, and banking-portal APIs.
Record user audits and publish transactional outbox events.

services.name: bff-webhook
responsibilities: Receive and validate GrabExpress webhook callbacks.
Receive Telegram webhook events.
Expose JWK information required by webhook security flows.

services.name: catalog-service
responsibilities: Manage product categories and subcategories.
Expose catalog lookup and maintenance APIs.
Coordinate category media with storage-service.

services.name: connector-service
responsibilities: Provide the boundary between eShop services and external providers.
Integrate with XPay, T24, Mobile TC, notification providers, and GrabExpress.
Manage external-provider access tokens and normalize provider responses.

services.name: delivery-service
responsibilities: Manage delivery companies, store delivery configuration, and delivery-fee rules.
Calculate delivery fees and determine delivery availability.
Request GrabExpress quotes, validate distance, package dimensions, weight, and operating time, and select BIKE or TRICYCLE.
Book Grab deliveries and process shipment status callbacks.

services.name: location-service
responsibilities: Provide province, district, and commune gazetteer data.
Resolve coordinates through geocoding and reverse-geocoding operations.
Provide location calculations used by delivery and store flows.

services.name: merchant-service
responsibilities: Manage merchant, partner, and merchant-team information.
Expose merchant account views and merchant lookup APIs.
Coordinate merchant operations with connector-service.

services.name: order-service
responsibilities: Create checkout forms and validate products, prices, stock, stores, customers, and delivery selections.
Create and manage orders, order items, payments, KHQR data, shipments, and shipment history.
Coordinate account, cart, connector, delivery, shop, stock, and refund workflows.
Book Grab delivery using the vehicle type persisted on TBL_ORD_SHIPMENT.

services.name: product-service
responsibilities: Manage products, variants, variant options and tiers, dimensions, images, brands, suppliers, units, VAT, and categories.
Support product search, wish lists, and product-click tracking.
Coordinate product media, account context, store settings, and stock-related records.

services.name: refund-service
responsibilities: Create and manage customer refund requests and refund items.
Store refund evidence and refund-payment records.
Read related order, payment, store, and customer data and coordinate external refund processing.

services.name: setting-service
responsibilities: Manage store-level settings.
Maintain store exchange rates and their history.
Expose exchange-rate configuration used by product, order, and delivery calculations.

services.name: shop-service
responsibilities: Manage stores, store profiles, addresses, files, opening hours, types, business types, and default-store settings.
Manage store members, roles, permissions, users, and followers.
Aggregate merchant, account, product, order, storage, location, and merchant-portal information for shop operations.

services.name: stock-service
responsibilities: Manage product-variant stock levels.
Record stock transactions, transaction items, and stock movements.
Expose inventory adjustment and stock lookup APIs.

services.name: storage-service
responsibilities: Store file metadata and temporary-upload metadata.
Handle product, shop, category, brand, company, marketing, and refund file operations.
Coordinate image background removal and image-detection providers.
